sutta: 1.10.14 monks as a matter concerning the external i know not of any other single factor so conducive to great profit as friendship with the lovely indeed friendship with the lovely conduces to great profit now these two sutas are trying to tell us that uh especially in the spiritual part having a good friend kalyana mitta sometimes they translate in the mahayana as a good knowing advisor that means somebody on the spiritual path with you is very important this is especially so for someone who is not established on the path someone who has not who does not yet have unshakable faith in the buddha dharma and sangha if you and if somebody who is interested in the dharma but in the beginning in the initial  steps of the path if he associate much with evil friends friends who are not interested in the dhamma friends who do not keep the sila the precepts who are not interested in to practice the spiritual path at all then it is for that person who is new on the path he is very easily influenced by his friends and he can uh lose his way along the path and go on the wrong track that's why the buddha says that friendship with somebody who's lovely and that means a spiritual friend who is well established on the spiritual path is very important for somebody new on the spiritual path in fact there's one suta where ananda friendship with the lovely is half of the spiritual life and the buddha said something likes no and then i know friendship with the lovely is all to do with the spiritual path so the buddha is always saying that having a good friend on the spiritual path one who is established in the way is very important
